artProposal.hair: Very long, thick, loose hair with a full crown and layered, slightly wavy lengths. Wispy strands frame the face; long, uneven side-swept bangs partially cross the forehead and eyes. The main mass falls down the back toward the hips, with separated, curling ends and long sections flowing forward over both shoulders.
artProposal.upper: A fitted black, corset-like bodice beneath the bust, with structured panels, narrow wine-red piping, and multiple horizontal dark straps across the waist. A prominent round dark-and-wine ring ornament sits at the center front of the waist, with a long wine-colored tab hanging below. A close, high black collar connects to angular black straps that frame the upper chest while leaving the neckline open. A smaller round dark-and-wine ornament is centered below the throat; narrow straps descend from it toward the bust and outer cup edges. The shoulders remain bare. Separate black off-shoulder sleeves begin around the upper arms, secured by narrow dark bands with wine-red accents. The sleeves are loose and billowy through the forearms, then gather into banded, ruffled cuffs.
artProposal.lower: 원본 허리 중심 원형 장식과 포도주색 벨트·늘어진 장식끈, 짧은 앞부분과 비대칭 긴 검정 치맛자락·포도주색 안감, 허벅지 레이스와 얇은 검정 스타킹. 바지로 교체하거나 원래 보이는 피부를 가리지 않음
artProposal.footwear: 원본의 검정 높은 굽 발목 부츠: 뾰족한 앞코, 가는 높은 굽, 붉은 연결 장식·버클 배치 유지
artProposal.headwear: On the anatomical left side of the head, two unequal mechanical discs, smaller beside larger, linked into a connected infinity silhouette. Dark centers with layered concentric segmented black-and-wine rims, preserved connecting bridge and slim hanging tassels. Not flowers, plain rings or unconnected clips.
artProposal.accessories: Long, matching dark-metal and wine-red drop earrings. Each has a small upper attachment, a slender open hoop, and a pointed wine-colored pendant hanging below.
